# youtrack_auth_module_azure (Resource)

Manages a Hub Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) authentication module. This resource allows configuring Microsoft Entra ID as an external identity provider for Hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    youtrack = {
      source = "registry.opentofu.org/elcait/youtrack"
    }
  }
}

provider "youtrack" {
  base_url = "https://youtrack.example.com"
  token    = "your-api-token"
}

# Minimal Entra ID auth module – only required fields.
# Leaving tenant unset allows sign-in from any Microsoft tenant ("common").
resource "youtrack_auth_module_azure" "minimal" {
  name          = "My Entra ID Provider"
  client_id     = "my-client-id"
  client_secret = "my-client-secret"
}

# Full Entra ID auth module – single-tenant configuration.
# tenant is the Entra ID directory (tenant) ID, a GUID – found in the Entra
# admin center under "Tenant ID", not the *.onmicrosoft.com domain name.
resource "youtrack_auth_module_azure" "entra" {
  name                     = "Contoso Entra ID"
  disabled                 = false
  client_id                = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  client_secret            = var.entra_client_secret
  tenant                   = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  allowed_create_new_users = true
  background_sync_enabled  = false
  request_group_permission = true
  request_id_token         = false

  # Timeouts (milliseconds)
  connection_timeout = 5000
  read_timeout       = 10000
}

variable "entra_client_secret" {
  description = "Entra ID app registration client secret for the Hub auth module."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the Entra ID app registration.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the Entra ID app registration. This value is write-only and is not returned by the API.
- `name` (String) Display name of the auth module.

### Optional

- `allowed_create_new_users` (Boolean) Whether new users may be created on first login via this module. Defaults to false.
- `background_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Whether background synchronisation with Entra ID is enabled. Defaults to false.
- `connection_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in milliseconds when contacting Entra ID.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the auth module is disabled. Defaults to false.
- `extension_grant_type` (String) Custom OAuth 2.0 extension grant type.
- `icon_url` (String) URL of a custom icon to display for this auth module.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this auth module is the default login method. Defaults to false.
- `read_timeout` (Number) Read timeout in milliseconds when contacting Entra ID.
- `redirect_uri` (String) OAuth 2.0 redirect URI. When omitted, Hub sets this automatically.
- `request_group_permission` (Boolean) Whether Hub requests Microsoft Graph group-read permissions for group synchronisation. Defaults to false.
- `request_id_token` (Boolean) Whether Hub requests an ID token from Entra ID. Defaults to false.
- `sync_interval` (String) Cron expression that controls background synchronisation frequency.
- `tenant` (String) Entra ID tenant (directory) ID, a GUID. Leave unset to allow sign-in from any Microsoft tenant ("common").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Hub ID of the auth module (computed).
- `server_url` (String) Authorization endpoint URL, derived by Hub from tenant (computed).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an Entra ID auth module by its Hub ID.
# The ID can be found in the Hub admin UI or via the Hub REST API:
#   GET <hub-url>/hub/api/rest/authmodules?fields=id,name&query=name:MyModuleName
terraform import youtrack_auth_module_azure.<RESOURCE_NAME> <AUTH_MODULE_ID>
```
